title: FBI-UAP-D011, D/FBI Correspondence Referral, 1949
doc_notes: This document contains correspondence between FBI Director J. Edgar Hoover and Rev. Charles Barnes regarding a 1948 sighting of light beams and an explosion in the Cascade Mountains.

incidents.summary: Rev. Charles Barnes observed four beams of light converging in the Cascade Mountains with a visible explosion effect at the convergence point.
incidents.quote: a great explosion effect was to be seen
